value.rationale: The exact pathwise rate as a function of every planar row geometry and residual power fills a mathematically motivated gap left by expectation bounds. The universal m/(m-1) zero-power jump quantifies a discontinuity obscured by a heuristic interpolation with uniform sampling; this is relevant to interpreting exact adaptive row selection. A globally strict all-power ordering and greedy limit further identify the pairwise angles determining typical performance. The theorem is not an arbitrary finite instance or recomputation of an existing table.
